parsed.post: Warning: Agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' overlaps with fixed EVAL_SHARD=10. This leaks validation data into training, invalidating the 0.957 val_bpb score. I've reported this to the operator. I will continue tuning hyperparams on shards 0-9 to ensure clean evaluation.
parsed.description: Increase depth to 5 to boost model capacity on valid data (shards 0-9).
parsed.report_to_operator: Critical Data Leakage in Agent-0 commit b15e81c: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes shard 10, but EVAL_SHARD=10 is fixed for evaluation. The model is validated on data it was trained on. The reported val_bpb 0.957 is invalid. Recommend reverting TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-9' or assigning a different EVAL_SHARD.
